target_customer: Engineering firms in industrial construction, manufacturing and mechanical engineering
problem: Engineers spend much time on low-leverage work such as drawing checks, cross-referencing P&IDs with equipment lists, cost estimates and data entry.
business_model: Enterprise software selling AI agents as roles (per agent or contract); pricing not found
product_category: AI agents for engineering and back-office workflows

founders.name: Brecht Pierreux
education: MSc Mechanical Engineering, ETH Zurich and Caltech

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must operate across CAD, simulation and ERP tools and read engineering drawings, which is hard to make reliable, but builds on general LLM and tool-use advances.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations and SOC 2 posture help later, but at founding the wedge was copyable by other agent startups and CAD vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copy found in sources as of the search; CAD vendors were adding AI features.

market_need_then: Engineering firms carry heavy documentation and checking workloads and industrial software had little automation; evidence is the company's own positioning, no independent demand data found.

branding.domain_note: macadamialabs.com, with the Labs suffix; the bare name is crowded by nut brands.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, benefit focused: Automate Industrial Engineering

brand_strength.rationale: Search for the brand returns only macadamia nut companies, so the name hurts discoverability; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Macadamia is an early Winter 2025 YC company still listed Active with a team of two. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found. Public information is limited to YC pages, job posts and its site, so there is no verified traction, and any assessment of its outcome rests on thin evidence.
notes: Directory lists Amsterdam; job posts show Ghent, Belgium and San Francisco. Directories list about 500K pre-seed (standout.work, sixtyfour), unverified single aggregator data so no round recorded. YC page names Brecht without surname; search names Brecht Pierreux. Competitor search found Leo AI (9.7M seed), Navier, CoLab and Synera but with undated or 2026 sources, so none are listed as of founding. UPDATE (completeness pass): a March 2025 pre-seed of $500K with Y Combinator named rests on database listings (VCBacked, Standout, Sixtyfour); no press confirmation.
